text: One of these doctors is a fake. Can you spot who?
Midnight. A patient's file vanishes. Four doctors were on the floor.
Doctor one: his pulse was seventy-two beats per minute.
Doctor two: his temperature was ninety-eight point six degrees Celsius.
Doctor three: his blood pressure was one-twenty over eighty.
Doctor four: I listened to his lungs. All clear.
Comment the number! The answer drops in the next video!
